description: Solo educational presentation project about Mars for young learners.
summary: "Ghost Fleet of the Red Planet" is an interactive, 7-slide visual storybook designed for school-age learners. Framed as a first-person 2045 astronaut mission log, the presentation answers top curiosity-driven questions about Mars by introducing the real NASA equipment left behind on the planet, including the Perseverance, Curiosity, and Opportunity rovers, the InSight lander, and the MOXIE oxygen experiment. By pairing dramatic storytelling with real NASA imagery and scientific discoveries, this project makes complex planetary science fun and easy for young readers to understand. AI tools were used to research popular Google search questions about Mars to guide this youth-friendly story.
details: "Ghost Fleet of the Red Planet" is an interactive 7-slide digital storybook built in Microsoft PowerPoint using custom open-book layouts, 3D models, and Morph transitions. Designed specifically for school-age learners, it turns complex Mars science into an exciting first-person 2045 astronaut mission log. Each page pairs a real curiosity-driven question with authentic NASA imagery and discoveries from discarded Mars equipment, including the Perseverance, Curiosity, and Opportunity rovers, the InSight lander, and the MOXIE oxygen experiment, making space exploration simple, visual, and fun for young readers.
